Class LogPattern.MessageEntry

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.LogPattern.AbstractLogPatternEntry
org.slb4j.LogPattern.MessageEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogPattern.LogPatternEntry
Enclosing class:
LogPattern
public static final class LogPattern.MessageEntry extends LogPattern.AbstractLogPatternEntry
Represents a specific implementation of AbstractLogPatternEntry for formatting log message content in a log entry. This class is responsible for formatting the log message text according to the provided parameters for minimum width, maximum width, and alignment.

  • Constructor Details

    • MessageEntry

      public MessageEntry(int minWidth, int maxWidth, boolean leftAlign)
      Constructs a new instance of MessageEntry with the specified formatting parameters.
      Parameters:
      minWidth - the minimum width of the formatted output. If the output is shorter than this width, padding will be added to meet the minimum length.
      maxWidth - the maximum width of the formatted output. If the output is longer than this width, it will be truncated to fit the specified maximum length.
      leftAlign - a flag indicating if the formatted output should be left-aligned. When set to true, padding is added to the right of the output; otherwise, it is added to the left.

  • Method Details

    • format

      public void format(Appendable app, long timestamp, String loggerName, LogLevel lvl, @Nullable String mrk, @Nullable MDC mdc, @Nullable Location location, Supplier<@Nullable String> msg, @Nullable Throwable t, ConsoleCode consoleCodes) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: LogPattern.LogPatternEntry
      Formats a log entry by appending its components to the given Appendable instance. This method is responsible for processing and serializing the provided log data into a custom format defined by the implementing class of the interface.
      Parameters:
      app - the Appendable instance to which the formatted log entry will be appended
      timestamp - the timestamp of the log event (milliseconds since epoch)
      loggerName - the name of the logger that generated the log event
      lvl - the LogLevel representing the severity level of the log event
      mrk - an optional marker for the log entry, or null if not provided
      mdc - an optional MDC containing diagnostic context data, or null if not provided
      location - an optional Location detailing the source of the log event, or null if unknown
      msg - a Supplier providing the log message, or null if not available
      t - an optional Throwable associated with the log event, or null if no exception occurred
      consoleCodes - a ConsoleCode defining console-specific format codes
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while appending to the Appendable instance
